newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Horse, dogs and goldfish join Serbian protest march.
newsitem.headline: Horse, dogs and goldfish join Serbian protest march.

text.p: Student protesters in Belgrade paraded with dogs, a horse and goldfish in a bowl on Friday to show that even animals support their pro-democracy protests.
Some 1,000 students marched with the animals from the veterinary faculty to Slavija Square and back again on the 61st day of daily pro-democracy protests across Serbia.
Some of the animals had tags draped around their necks to show they were members of the student protest board and supported the students' demands.

A sign said the fish had been rendered dumb by watching Serbian television. The state-run channel has ignored the demonstrations and protesters have retaliated by banging pots and blowing whistles every night to drown out the news.
The students began their march walking in the street but a contingent of riot police forced them onto the sidewalk, temporarily disturbing some of the animals.
Otherwise the protest went off without incident.
The students and the opposition Zajedno (Together) coalition are demanding reinstatement of Zajedno victories in November 17 municipal elections.
The opposition won in 14 of Serbia's 18 biggest cities, but President Slobodan Milosevic's Socialist government, citing "irregularities", annulled the results.
